queries.text:
System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend HardwareModel = trim(" ", strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel))
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
| where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel) or isempty(_hardwareModel)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host
| extend OsBuildUbr = strcat(tostring(OsBuild), ".", tostring(OsUpdateBuildRevision))
| summarize
    HostCount = dcount(Host),
    OsNameCount = dcount(OsName),
    OsVersionCount = dcount(OsVersion),
    OsBuildCount = dcount(OsBuildUbr),
    OsTypeCount = dcount(OsType),
    OsArchitectureCount = dcount(OsArchitecture),
    ManufacturerCount = dcount(HwManufacturer),
    BiosVersionCount = dcount(HwBiosVersion),
    CpuModelCount = dcount(CPUName),
    RamSizeCount = dcount(RAMSizeGB)
    by HardwareModel
| order by HostCount desc

System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend HardwareModel = trim(" ", strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel))
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
| where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel) or isempty(_hardwareModel)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Host) by HardwareModel
| top 10 by HostCount desc

System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend HardwareModel = trim(" ", strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel))
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
| where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel) or isempty(_hardwareModel)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Host) by OsName
| top 10 by HostCount desc
| project OperatingSystem = OsName, HostCount

System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend HardwareModel = trim(" ", strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel))
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
| where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel) or isempty(_hardwareModel)
| where isnotnull(OsUpdateBuildRevision)
| extend OsBuildUbr = strcat(tostring(OsBuild), ".", tostring(OsUpdateBuildRevision))
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Host) by bin(Timestamp, 1d), OsBuildUbr
| order by Timestamp asc

let Machine =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(" ", strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel))
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel) or isempty(_hardwareModel)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host;
let Monitor =
    System_MonitorInventory
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | summarize
        MonitorCount = dcount(MonitorIndex),
        MonitorNames = make_set(MonitorDisplayName, 16),
        MonitorResolutions = make_set(strcat(tostring(MonitorHRes), "x", tostring(MonitorVRes)), 16)
        by Host;
let Network =
    System_NetworkConfigInformation
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | summarize
        NetworkAdapters = make_set(NetworkConfigFriendlyName, 16),
        NetworkDescriptions = make_set(NetworkConfigDescription, 16),
        IPv4Addresses = make_set(tostring(NetworkConfigIPv4), 32)
        by Host;
Machine
| join kind=leftouter Monitor on Host
| join kind=leftouter Network on Host
| extend OsBuildUbr = strcat(tostring(OsBuild), ".", tostring(OsUpdateBuildRevision))
| project
    Host,
    AdDomainDns,
    AdDomainNetBios,
    AdOu,
    AdSite,
    ComputerNameCanonical,
    ComputerNameDn,
    CPUName,
    CPUCoresLogical,
    CPUCoresPhysical,
    CPUMaxMhz,
    CPUSockets,
    RAMSizeGB,
    HwManufacturer,
    HwModel,
    HwBiosVersion,
    BIOSSerial,
    BaseboardSerial,
    HwIsVirtualMachine,
    HwHypervisorVendor,
    IsBatteryPresent,
    BatteryWearLevelPercent,
    OsName,
    OsType,
    OsVersion,
    OsBuild,
    OsUpdateBuildRevision,
    OsBuildUbr,
    OsArchitecture,
    OsInstallDate,
    OsInstallDateOriginal,
    CtxFarmName,
    CtxMachineCatalogName,
    CtxDeliveryGroupName,
    CoverageEndDate,
    MonitorCount,
    MonitorNames,
    MonitorResolutions,
    NetworkAdapters,
    NetworkDescriptions,
    IPv4Addresses
| order by Host asc

let Volume =
    System_VolumeInventory
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host, Guid
    | extend DiskNumberText = split(DiskNumbers, ";")
    | mv-expand DiskNumberText to typeof(string)
    | extend DiskNumber = tolong(DiskNumberText)
    | project
        Host,
        VolumeGuid = Guid,
        Path = MountPoints,
        Label,
        FileSystem,
        FreeMB,
        CapacityMB,
        UsedSpacePercent,
        PartitionStyle,
        IsSystemVolume,
        IsBootVolume,
        IsDirty,
        DiskNumber,
        DeviceName;
let Disk =
    System_DiskInventory
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host, DiskNumber
    | project
        Host,
        DiskNumber,
        DiskName = Name,
        Enumerator,
        DiskCapacityMB = CapacityMB,
        IsRemovable,
        IsWritable;
Volume
| join kind=leftouter Disk on Host, DiskNumber
| extend
    FreeSpaceGB = round(toreal(FreeMB) / 1024.0, 1),
    UsedSpaceGB = round((toreal(CapacityMB) * UsedSpacePercent / 100.0) / 1024.0, 1),
    CapacityGB = round(toreal(CapacityMB) / 1024.0, 1)
| project
    Host,
    Path,
    Label,
    FileSystem,
    FreeSpaceGB,
    UsedSpaceGB,
    CapacityGB,
    UsedSpacePercent,
    DiskName,
    Enumerator,
    DiskCapacityMB,
    PartitionStyle,
    IsSystemVolume,
    IsBootVolume,
    IsDirty,
    IsRemovable,
    IsWritable
| order by Host asc, Path asc

Application_ApplicationInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where DisplayName in (_application) or isempty(_application)
| summarize InstallCount = dcount(Host) by DisplayName
| top 10 by InstallCount desc
| project Name = DisplayName, InstallCount

Application_ApplicationInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where DisplayName in (_application) or isempty(_application)
| summarize InstallCount = dcount(strcat(Host, "|", DisplayName)) by Publisher
| top 10 by InstallCount desc
| project Publisher, InstallCount

let AllHosts = toscalar(
    Application_ApplicationInventory
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | summarize dcount(Host)
);
Application_ApplicationInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where DisplayName in (_application) or isempty(_application)
| summarize
    Publisher = take_any(Publisher),
    Installations = dcount(Host),
    VersionCount = dcount(DisplayVersion),
    LanguageCount = dcount(Language),
    InstallLocationCount = dcount(InstallLocation)
    by DisplayName
| extend NotInstalled = AllHosts - Installations
| project
    Name = DisplayName,
    Publisher,
    Installations,
    NotInstalled,
    VersionCount,
    LanguageCount,
    InstallLocationCount
| order by Name asc

Application_SoftwareUpdateInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where State in (_updateState) or isempty(_updateState)
| summarize InstallCount = dcount(strcat(Host, "|", tostring(Guid))) by State
| top 10 by InstallCount desc
| project State, InstallCount

Application_SoftwareUpdateInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where State in (_updateState) or isempty(_updateState)
| summarize
    Name = take_any(DisplayName),
    InstallCount = dcount(Host)
    by Guid
| top 10 by InstallCount desc
| project Guid, Name, InstallCount

let AllHosts = toscalar(
    Application_SoftwareUpdateInventory
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | summarize dcount(Host)
);
Application_SoftwareUpdateInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where State in (_updateState) or isempty(_updateState)
| summarize
    Name = take_any(DisplayName),
    Product = take_any(ProductName),
    Installations = dcount(Host),
    StateCount = dcount(State),
    States = make_set(State, 16)
    by Guid
| extend NotInstalled = AllHosts - Installations
| project
    Guid,
    Name,
    Product,
    Installations,
    NotInstalled,
    StateCount,
    States
| order by Name asc

System_NetworkConfigInformation
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host, NetworkConfigFriendlyName
| project
    Host,
    NetworkAdapter = NetworkConfigFriendlyName,
    Description = NetworkConfigDescription,
    DnsSuffix = NetworkConfigDnsSuffix,
    InterfaceType = NetworkConfigInterfaceType,
    IPv4 = NetworkConfigIPv4,
    IPv6 = NetworkConfigIPv6,
    ConnectedToInternet = NetworkConfigIsConnectedToInternet,
    MacAddress = NetworkConfigMACAddress,
    Ssid = NetworkConfigSsid,
    WiFiAuthentication = NetworkConfigWiFiAuthentication,
    WiFiType = NetworkConfigWiFiType,
    WiFiSignalQuality = NetworkConfigWiFiSignalQuality
| order by Host asc, NetworkAdapter asc

System_NetworkConfigInformation
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host, NetworkConfigFriendlyName
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Host) by NetworkConfigFriendlyName
| top 10 by HostCount desc
| project NetworkAdapter = NetworkConfigFriendlyName, HostCount

System_NetworkConfigInformation
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host, NetworkConfigFriendlyName
| summarize
    HostCount = dcount(Host),
    InterfaceTypeCount = dcount(NetworkConfigInterfaceType),
    NetworkAdapterCount = dcount(NetworkConfigFriendlyName),
    DnsSuffixCount = dcount(NetworkConfigDnsSuffix),
    SsidCount = dcount(NetworkConfigSsid),
    IPv4SetCount = dcount(tostring(NetworkConfigIPv4)),
    IPv6SetCount = dcount(tostring(NetworkConfigIPv6))

System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnotempty(Host)
| summarize by Value = Host
| extend Label = Value
| order by Label asc

System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where isnotempty(OsName)
| summarize by Value = OsName
| extend Label = Value
| order by Label asc

System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
| extend HardwareModel = trim(" ", strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel))
| where isnotempty(HardwareModel)
| summarize by Value = HardwareModel
| extend Label = Value
| order by Label asc

Application_ApplicationInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where isnotempty(DisplayName)
| summarize by Value = DisplayName
| extend Label = Value
| order by Label asc

Application_SoftwareUpdateInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where isnotempty(State)
| summarize by Value = tostring(State)
| extend Label = Value
| order by Label asc
